verdict: FAIL_SOURCE_GATE. M1966 correctly introduces per-side valids wired independently to the two DUT and SVA instances, independently latches each load_accept, deasserts only the accepted side, holds the shared descriptor payload until both sides accept, and adds an exact 10000-cycle bound to every full and recovery descriptor. It nevertheless fails four mandatory controls from sealed M1965: the first descriptor of full and recovery phases is asserted with blocking assignments in the active region of a sampling posedge, there is no whole-test watchdog armed before the first load, both join_any completion blocks leave orphan timeout threads because there is no disable fork, and phase/timeout diagnostics are incomplete. The additive source is not authorized for a fresh runner or any EDA attempt.

delta_audit.filelist_delta: Only the final TB path changes from M1942 to M1966.

m1965_compliance.accepted_side_deassert_before_next_sampl: PASS after an observed accept via NBA
m1965_compliance.shared_payload_stability: PASS structurally while either side remains pending
m1965_compliance.race_free_descriptor_assertion: FAIL: first full/recovery descriptor is asserted in active region of a posedge
m1965_compliance.per_load_watchdog: PARTIAL: exact 10000-cycle bound exists but diagnostics are insufficient
m1965_compliance.named_completion_fork_cleanup: FAIL: two join_any blocks and zero disable-fork statements remain
m1965_compliance.complete_phase_tokens: FAIL: only four load begin/complete tokens exist
m1965_compliance.timeout_token_and_state_dump: FAIL: generic fatal omits phase, descriptor identity, per-side pending/handshake/fault/busy state

p1_findings: P1-1: M1966 asserts the first descriptor immediately after a posedge-triggered reset release/recovery wait. Because DUT always_ff sampling and the initial thread share the active region, a DUT may consume that descriptor on the current edge while the task begins observing only the next edge, causing duplicate presentation and possible ST_FAULT.
P1-2: no whole-test watchdog is armed before reset release or load_workload; only per-load loops and post-load execute watchdogs exist.
P1-3: both completion blocks retain fork/join_any without named-fork cleanup or disable fork, so completion waiters and fatal watchdogs can survive their phase.
P1-4: only full/recovery load begin/complete tokens were added; reset, execute, both attacks, recovery execute, final checks, timeout token, and timeout state dump are missing.
required_next_gate: Author one additive successor TB preserving M1966 split-valid/latched-accept behavior while moving all descriptor assertion to negedge or a skewed clocking block, arming a whole-test watchdog before the first load, replacing both join_any blocks with named forks plus cleanup or bounded both-done waits, and adding the full M1965 phase/timeout diagnostics. A different-author source hammer must bind exact sealed M1965 and approve that successor before any fresh runner may be authored. M1967 authorizes no runner and no EDA.
